minutes.headline: Select Board heard a strong FY21 close and backed a comment letter against the Pondview Commons 40B.
minutes.summary: The board ratified a police hire and a temporary veterans agent, appointed a housing authority tenant member, and heard the FY21 fourth-quarter financial report showing revenue and closeouts above estimates. It authorized the town manager to compile the 40B comment letter, approved changed earth removal hours, funded a boundary survey, and directed a revised landscape RFP for 30 School Street.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 5-0 to authorize the town manager to compile public comments and work with town counsel on a cover letter for the 40B comment submission.
The finance director's fourth-quarter report showed FY21 revenue collections above estimates, with local receipts and state aid both ahead of what was budgeted.
The board approved the earth removal permit renewal with weekday hours and a shorter Saturday window.
The board approved a boundary survey and staking of three possible encroachments on conservation property; the remaining 24 will be surveyed one at a time.
The board directed a revised RFP for a 30 School Street landscape architect, to return on the September 7 agenda, after noting the scope might exceed the appropriation.

why_it_matters: The 40B comment letter is the town's formal response to a state-permitted housing proposal, which can override local zoning, so what the letter says shapes what the town can ask for.
Revenue that came in above conservative pandemic-era estimates feeds free cash, which residents are asked to vote on at town meeting.
If the 30 School Street design work costs more than the existing appropriation, a special town meeting vote could be needed.
watch_next: The September 7 Select Board agenda, when the revised 30 School Street RFP is due back.
The finance director's free cash estimate, which the minutes describe as up from the prior certified amount.

The main differences are the earth removal motion, the free cash estimate, the 30 School Street RFP scope, and attendee names.
